original_failed_cut.reason: Original runner created an empty Claude provider directory, contradicting the missing-home scenario. Counterpart keeps every test byte unchanged and uses an explicitly nonexistent owned Claude path. The original result remains failed/incomplete, not retrospectively green.

git_failure_antecedent.reason: A metadata-hint test observed a directory fallback instead of origin; the earlier node passed and the failed cut did not record its reason. No retrospective cause attribution. Final run records the public result without modifying it.

limits: Counts cover the three explicit qualifying cuts only; original failed/incomplete cuts are separate.
Closed PIPE skips are literal skips; prior real console/WSL evidence is version-scoped separately.
No provider/authentication, human/AT, universal platform or original broad-regression qualification.
Parent application origins/payloads are guarded; nested-child provenance is limited to each unchanged test/proof.
